name: Amul (GCMMF)
description: Amul is India's largest dairy cooperative, owned by GCMMF - a federation of Gujarat milk producer unions. Famous for butter, milk and a full dairy range under the 'Taste of India' brand.

name: Mother Dairy
parent_company: Mother Dairy Fruit & Vegetable Pvt Ltd
description: Mother Dairy is a wholly-owned subsidiary of NDDB, a major milk supplier in Delhi-NCR with token/pouch milk, ice creams and the Safal and Dhara brands.

name: Nestle India
description: Nestle India is the Indian arm of Swiss FMCG giant Nestle; dairy brands include Nestle Milk, EveryDay milk powder, Milkpak, and dahi, sold alongside foods like Maggi.

name: Heritage Foods
description: Heritage Foods is a Hyderabad-based listed dairy founded in 1992 by N. Chandrababu Naidu, strong in South India with milk, curd and value-added products.

name: Verka (Milkfed)
description: Verka is the brand of Milkfed Punjab Co-operative Milk Producers Federation, the state cooperative of Punjab selling milk, ghee, paneer, sweets and beverages.

name: Dodla Dairy
description: Dodla Dairy is a Hyderabad-based listed dairy company operating primarily in South India with milk, curd, butter, ghee and paneer across four states.

name: Britannia Industries
description: Britannia is a leading Indian FMCG company famous for biscuits, with a growing dairy portfolio including cheese, ghee, dahi and milk drinks under Wadia Group ownership.

name: Parag Milk Foods
description: Parag Milk Foods is a listed private dairy owning Gowardhan ghee, Go Cheese, Pride of Cows premium milk and the Akashganga brands, with one of India's largest private dairy farms.

name: Hatsun Agro
description: Hatsun Agro Product is India's largest private dairy by volume, owning Arun Ice Cream, Arokya milk and Hatsun brand, exporting to 40+ countries.

name: Dudhsagar Dairy
description: Dudhsagar Dairy is the Mehsana District Cooperative Milk Producers Union of Gujarat, part of the Amul federation pattern, known for butter and milk products.

name: Warana Dairy
description: Warana Dairy is part of the Warana Group cooperative in Kolhapur, Maharashtra, producing milk, ghee, paneer and shrikhand for western India.

name: Milma
description: Milma is the brand of Kerala Co-operative Milk Marketing Federation (KCMMF), the state cooperative serving Kerala with milk, curd, ghee and sreekand.

name: Nandini (KMF)
description: Nandini is the brand of Karnataka Milk Federation (KMF), one of India's largest dairy cooperatives, dominant in Karnataka with a full milk and products range.

name: Govardhan Dairy
description: Gowardhan is Parag Milk Foods' traditional dairy brand, India's largest maker of cow-based ghee and cheese under the Gowardhan and Go labels.

name: Akshayakalpa
description: Akshayakalpa Organic is a Bengaluru-based organic dairy startup running farmer-owned organic farms, delivering antibiotic-free milk direct to consumers in South Indian metros.
